title: NEMA17 Engineering
detail: NEMA 17 | STEPPERONLINE 17HS19-2004S1 | engineering reference · Self-contained native ProGen3D grammar. Paper Studio Android 0.82. · Start arguments: section (0 assembled / 1 longitudinal cutaway), full steps/s, · direction (+1/-1), shaft projection in mm, flat length in mm. · Set the rate to 0 to park. Use a positive projection with 0 < flat < projection. · One grammar unit = one millimetre throughout, including the assembly interfaces. · Origin: mounting face centre, +Z out of shaft, +X normal to flat at t=0. · Positive direction is CCW viewed from the output end. Ideal command position. · Front taps are open smooth 2.5 mm minor-bore representations of M3 x 0.5. · They terminate 4.5 mm behind the mounting face. Threads are schematic.
